description:
TaskMan of London lets AI agents help users find, price, and book real home services across Greater London.

Use it for:

Furniture assembly
Wall mounting
Handyman jobs
Electrician work
Smart home installation
The server supports:

Service discovery
London coverage checks by postcode
Ballpark quote estimates
Availability checks
Booking request creation
Booking status lookup
Existing-customer verification and customer-scoped booking flows
Best for consumer-facing assistants, concierge agents, property workflows, relocation support, and home services automation in London.
